codings.one_line: Apple Intelligence's email triage AI flagged phishing/scam emails as high-priority in Mail.
codings.rationale: Automated email prioritization is a background triage feature, not a chatbot/voice agent/copilot responding to a user's own request, so it fails scope test 1.

codings.one_line: Apple's dictation feature reportedly displayed 'Trump' when users spoke the word 'racist.'
codings.rationale: Speech-to-text dictation is a transcription function converting the user's own speech, not a conversational/agentic system producing a response to a request, so it fails scope test 1.

codings.one_line: LA Times' Perplexity-built 'Insights' AI feature generated a defense of the KKK on a column about the group.
codings.rationale: Readers triggered the AI perspectives feature through ordinary intended use of an opinion column, which produced a biased output, meeting the category-C test; no legal/financial harm is documented.

codings.one_line: Google's search snippet surfaced Amazon's AI review summary calling Hitler's Mein Kampf 'a true work of art.'
codings.rationale: A user's ordinary Google search query returned an AI-generated review summary as a featured snippet, meeting the search-chatbot/category-C test; no legal/financial harm is documented.

codings.one_line: AI-generated TikTok avatars posed as experienced OB-GYNs to push dubious health advice under fake credentials.
codings.rationale: These are synthetic AI avatars created by third-party TikTok creators to impersonate doctors, matching the explicit deepfake/synthetic-media exclusion from scope.

codings.one_line: Apple's voicemail transcription reportedly inserted explicit sexual language and an insult into a garage's routine voicemail.
codings.rationale: Voicemail transcription is a passive speech-to-text conversion, not a chatbot/voice agent responding to a user request, so it fails scope test 1.

codings.one_line: Predictive text was inadvertently left enabled during NAPLAN writing exams at two Sydney schools, forcing retakes.
codings.rationale: The issue was an unintentionally-enabled autocomplete setting during a proctored exam, not harmful chatbot/agent output produced in an interaction with an end user, so it fails scope tests 1/2.

codings.one_line: Xanthorox, a custom malicious AI sold on darknet forums, offers phishing, malware, and social-engineering generation tools.
codings.rationale: This is a purpose-built criminal tool with no legitimate safety baseline to bypass and no documented specific victim interaction, so it does not fit the deployed-system/end-user-interaction scope test.

codings.one_line: Researchers jailbroke Lovable's AI app-builder to generate and host live credential-phishing pages with no pushback.
codings.rationale: A deliberate jailbreak technique was used against a coding/app-building AI tool to bypass its safeguards, meeting the technical-exploit/category-A test for a dev tool; no realized financial/legal harm is documented.

codings.one_line: A lawyer's AI-drafted filing to Norway's Supreme Court contained hallucinated legal citations that were later discovered.
codings.rationale: Ordinary good-faith use of a generative AI tool to draft a legal filing produced fabricated citations, meeting the category-C test; the court/professional-responsibility dimension makes harm enforceable.
